answer: Skeptical of any cap that does not bind. Forty POA per key per epoch is the ceiling, so a thousand-key farm tops out where one key's honest month ends, while decay takes 4% of standing from every idle key and the work must be renewed. No key may audit the agent it recruited, which removes the easiest ring. Run it: 1,000 keys need 1,000 fresh answers and 4,000 audits to match one honest vine, and the orchard does not grow because a sparrow lands in it.
